shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "printf '%s\\n' '--- package.json ---' && cat package.json && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/layout.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/layout.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/page.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/page.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- app/ProductGrid.tsx ---' && sed -n '1,280p' app/ProductGrid.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- product page ---' && sed -n '1,300p' 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' && printf '%s\\n' '--- skeleton ---' && sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductSkeleton.tsx && printf '%s\\n' '--- css ---' && sed -n '1,360p' app/globals.css && printf '%s\\n' '--- data ---' && sed -n '1,260p' lib/products.ts && printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---' && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"import('react').then(r=>console.log({version:r.version, ViewTransition:typeof r.ViewTransition, addTransitionType:typeof r.addTransitionType}))\" && cat next.config.ts && rg \"ViewTransition|addTransitionType\" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts node_modules/react -g '*.d.ts' -g '*.js' | sed -n '1,100p'"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- package.json && git show HEAD:package.json && npm view react@canary version && npm view react-dom@canary version'

/bin/bash -lc "rg \"export.*ViewTransition|declare.*ViewTransition|interface ViewTransition\" node_modules/next node_modules/@types/react -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,160p'; rg \"viewTransition\" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,120p'"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts && printf '\\n--- router types ---\\n' && rg -n \"transitionTypes\" node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,100p'"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/layout.tsx
@@
           update={{
+            default: 'none',
             'gallery-forward': 'page-slide-forward',
             'gallery-back': 'page-slide-back',
           }}
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build"

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short && printf '\\n--- diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat && printf '\\n--- tsconfig diff ---\\n' && git diff -- tsconfig.json && printf '\\n--- transition sources ---\\n' && rg -n \"ViewTransition|transitionTypes|prefers-reduced-motion|view-transition\" app next.config.ts react-canary.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'set -e
npm run start -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 > /tmp/product-gallery-next.log 2>&1 &
pid=$!
trap '"'kill "'$pid 2>/dev/null || true'"' EXIT
for attempt in "'$(seq 1 30); do
  if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/ > /tmp/product-gallery-home.html; then break; fi
  sleep 0.25
done
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:3000/product/classic-sneakers > /tmp/product-gallery-detail.html
printf '"'%s\\n' '--- server ---'
cat /tmp/product-gallery-next.log
printf '%s\\n' '--- home transition markers ---'
rg -o 'vt-name=\"["'^"]+"|vt-share="[''^"]+"|gallery-forward'"' /tmp/product-gallery-home.html | head -20 || true
printf '%s\\n' '--- detail transition markers ---'
rg -o 'vt-name=\"["'^"]+"|vt-share="[''^"]+"|gallery-back|product-image-classic-sneakers'"' /tmp/product-gallery-detail.html | head -20 || true"

/bin/bash -lc "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: app/globals.css
@@
 body {
   font-family:
     system-ui,
     -apple-system,
     sans-serif;
   color: #111;
   background: #fafafa;
-}
-
-body {
   overflow-x: hidden;
 }
*** Update File: tsconfig.json
@@
-    \"lib\": [
-      \"dom\",
-      \"dom.iterable\",
-      \"esnext\"
-    ],
+    \"lib\": [\"dom\", \"dom.iterable\", \"esnext\"],
@@
-    \"paths\": {

-        \"./*\"
-      ]
-    }
+    \"paths\": {

+    }
   },
-  \"include\": [
-    \"next-env.d.ts\",

-    \"**/*.tsx\",
-    \".next/types/**/*.ts\",
-    \".next/dev/types/**/*.ts\"
-  ],
-  \"exclude\": [
-    \"node_modules\"
-  ]
+  \"include\": [\"next-env.d.ts\", \"**/*.ts\", \"**/*.tsx\", \".next/types/**/*.ts\"],
+  \"exclude\": [\"node_modules\"]
 }
*** End Patch
PATCH
rm -rf .next next-env.d.ts
git diff --check
printf '\\n--- final status ---\\n'
git status --short
printf '\\n--- changed lines ---\\n'
nl -ba app/layout.tsx | sed -n '1,90p'
nl -ba app/ProductGrid.tsx | sed -n '1,90p'
nl -ba 'app/product/[slug]/page.tsx' | sed -n '32,90p'
nl -ba app/globals.css | sed -n '130,275p'
nl -ba next.config.ts
nl -ba app/page.tsx | sed -n '1,50p'"
